title: The Nick W. Alarm Clock
about: Two Prep Week mornings when Nick W. replaced the alarm clock with an electric guitar and amplifier.
description: This track remembers two mornings during Prep Week when Nick W. brought an amp in beside the showers and started playing electric guitar before everyone was ready to be awake. The sound carried through the dorm, waking room after room and, as I remember it, possibly reaching the girls' side too. It was loud, ridiculous, and far more effective than any normal alarm clock.
lyrics: Nick plugged in beside the showers,
Down the hall and through the building,
There was nowhere you could hide.
Pretty sure the girls could hear it
All the way on their side.
Two mornings out of Prep Week,
Not to bells or someone shouting,
Just an amp turned up inside—
From the showers down the hall.
